# Hash-pinned wheels bundled into the .deb (scripts/build-deb.sh), installed with
# --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: --no-deps into the package tree. These are
# the GUI toolkit + X11 helpers not depended on via apt (see build-deb.sh);
# cryptography stays an apt dependency. Keep versions in step with
# requirements-appimage.txt; regenerate hashes from PyPI when a version bumps.
#
# PySide6-Essentials, not the PySide6 meta-package: the meta-package also
# pulls PySide6-Addons (~167 MB of Qt modules this app never uses). Essentials
# alone provides QtCore/QtGui/QtWidgets under the `PySide6.*` namespace.
